Recept: 12-Minute Pork Chops
Beschrijving: Quick and nutritious pork chops cooked in under 15 minutes, served over rice with red peppers and onions, ideal for athletes.
Bereidingstijd: 10

Ingrediënten:
- 6 pork chops
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 medium onion (chopped)
- 2 cups rice
- 1 red pepper (finely chopped)
- ½ (14.5 oz) can beef broth
- 1/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette dressing
- 1/4 tsp dried rosemary

Instructies:
1. Heat oil in large non-stick pan on medium-high heat.
2. Add chops; cook 6 min. Turn after 3 minutes. Remove from skillet and cover to keep warm.
3. Add onions to same pan. Cook 5 min. stirring occasionally.
4. Stir in rice, peppers, broth, dressing and rosemary. Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer 15 min.
5. Serve chops over rice, quinoa or barley dish and some colorful vegetables.

__data__.text:
Titel: 12-Minute Pork Chops
Tags: dinner, Global, pork chops, rice, red pepper, high protein, iron-rich, quick meal

metadata.Full_recipe:
Recept: Caesar salad with chicory
Beschrijving: Chicory is the hero in this Caesar salad with spicy chicken. The classic ingredients like anchovies, eggs, and a creamy dressing are retained but given more flavor and texture. A surprisingly delicious upgrade of the classic, with extra crunch and character.
Bereidingstijd: 45 min

Ingrediënten:
- 300 g chicken thighs
-  curry powder
-  pepper
-  salt
- 1 head lettuce
- 100 g spinach
- 6 heads chicory
- 100 g mayonnaise
- 3 anchovy fillets
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- 3 sprigs parsley
-  olive oil
- 4 eggs
- 4 anchovy fillets
- 50 g Brokkeloud Roeselare or Flandrien Grand Cru cheese (coarsely grated)
- 4 sprigs parsley (fresh)
- 1 tbsp lemon zest
-  fleur de sel

Instructies:
1. Season the chicken thigh meat with curry powder, pepper, and salt. Fry until cooked and crispy in a hot pan.
2. Wash the lettuce, spinach, and chicory. Cut the lettuce into large pieces.
3. Arrange the lettuce, spinach, and chicory leaves in a large bowl.
4. Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water. Peel and cut in half.
5. Mix the mayonnaise with the anchovies, lemon juice, and parsley. Season to taste with pepper and olive oil, and optionally some extra lemon juice.
6. Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with fleur de sel.
7. Pick the meat from the chicken thighs and cut or tear into pieces. Distribute over the salad along with the eggs and some anchovy fillets.
8. Spoon plenty of the dressing over. Finish with coarsely grated cheese, fresh parsley, and lemon zest.

__data__.text:
Titel: Caesar salad with chicory
Tags: dinner, Belgian, chicory, chicken, lettuce, salad, easy, cheese, anchovy, egg

metadata.Full_recipe:
Recept: Savory Polenta
Beschrijving: Savory polenta made with cornmeal, chicken stock, and Parmesan, served creamy or grilled, and pairs well with proteins and vegetables.
Bereidingstijd: 15 min

Ingrediënten:
- 2 tbsp olive oil (plus extra for grilling or sautéing if desired)
- 1 medium red onion (finely chopped)
- 2 cloves garlic (finely minced)
- 4 cups chicken stock or broth
- 1 cup cornmeal (coarse ground)
- 1 ½ tsp kosher salt
- ¼ tsp black pepper (freshly ground)
- 2 ounces Parmesan (grated)

Instructies:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Saucepan (large, oven-safe): heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the red onion and salt and sauté until the onions start to get soft (~4 – 5 min.). Reduce the heat to low, add the garlic, and sauté for 1 – 2 minutes (be sure to not burn to garlic).
3. Turn the heat to high, add the chicken stock, bring to a boil. Gradually add the cornmeal while continually whisking.
4. Once all of the cornmeal is added, cover the pot and place it in the oven. Cook for 35 – 40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes to prevent lumps.
5. Once the mixture is creamy, remove from the oven and add the salt, and pepper and parmesan, gradually.
6. Two ways to serve:
   * Option 1: Serve as is.
   * Option 2: Pour the polenta into 9 x 13-inch cake pan lined with parchment paper. Place in the refrigerator to cool completely. Once cooled and set, turn the polenta out onto a cutting board and cut into squares, rounds, or triangles. Brush each side with olive oil and sauté in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, or grill.

__data__.text:
Titel: Savory Polenta
Tags: dinner, Italian, cornmeal, chicken stock or broth, Parmesan

Recept: Grilled Salmon and Avocado Pitas
Beschrijving: Grilled salmon and avocado served in whole wheat pita rounds with arugula, tomato, and a wasabi mayonnaise dressing.
Bereidingstijd: 15

Ingrediënten:
- 1 tbsp wasabi paste
- 2 tsp soy sauce
- 2 tsp rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup mayonnaise (or similar)
- 1/2 lb. salmon or arctic char fillet
- 2 tsp olive oil
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 whole wheat pita rounds
- 1/2 ripe avocado (diced)
- 2 cup arugula (or any salad greens)
- 1 medium tomato (seeded and diced)

Instructies:
1. In a small bowl, combine the wasabi paste, soy sauce, vinegar, and mayonnaise. Set aside.
2. Brush salmon with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
3. Grill (either oiled charcoal or gas grill, 450° to 550°). Lay salmon on an; close lid on gas grill.
4. Grill 6 to 8 minutes depending on thickness, turning over once, until just barely done (cut to test; flesh will be a darker shade of pink in the center). Remove from grill and quickly toast pita rounds on grill, about 2 minutes, turning once.
5. Cut or flake salmon into 1-in. cubes.
6. Cut pita rounds in half and spread wasabi mayonnaise on insides. Fill each pita half with salmon, avocado, arugula (or salad greens) and tomatoes, dividing equally.

__data__.text:
Titel: Grilled Salmon and Avocado Pitas
Tags: lunch, Global, salmon, pita, avocado, grilled, healthy, sandwich

Recept: Chilaquiles Casserole
Beschrijving: A baked casserole version of chilaquiles with vegetables, beans, tortillas, and cheese.
Bereidingstijd: 25

Ingrediënten:
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 medium onion (diced)
- 1 medium zucchini (grated)
- 1 19oz. can black beans (rinsed)
- 1 14oz can diced tomatoes (drained)
- 1 ½ cups corn (frozen (thawed) or fresh)
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- ½ tsp salt
- 12 corn tortillas (quartered)
- 3-4 whole-wheat tortillas (quartered)
- 1 19oz can mild red or green enchilada sauce
- 1 ¼ cups shredded reduced-fat Cheddar cheese

Instructies:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Lightly coat a 9 x 13” baking pan with cooking spray or similar.
2. Pan: Heat oil in over medium-high heat. Add onion, stir often until start to brown (~ 5 min.). Stir in zucchini, beans, tomatoes, corn, cumin and salt and cook. Stir occasionally, until the vegetables are heated through (~3 min).
3. Scatter half the tortilla pieces in the pan. Top with half the vegetable mixture, half the enchilada sauce and half the cheese. Repeat with one more layer of tortillas, vegetables, sauce and cheese. Cover with foil.
4. Bake for 15 min. with foil. Remove foil and continue baking until the casserole is bubbling around the edges and the cheese is melted (~ 10 min).

__data__.text:
Titel: Chilaquiles Casserole
Tags: dinner, Mexican, black beans, tortillas, cheese

Recept: Chicken Shawarma - Wrap or Buddha Bowl
Beschrijving: Easy to make, this scrumptious Chicken Shawarma is protein rich and covered in antioxidant and anti-inflammatory spices. Add herbs, veggies and yogurt sauce for additional nutrients and serve as a wrap or as a Buddha Bowl and you have a great meal for supporting your training and recovery.
Bereidingstijd: 

Ingrediënten:
- 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs
- 2 tsp paprika
- 2 tsp cumin
- 3 – 4 cloves or 1 tsp garlic cloves or garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp allspice
- 1 tsp ground turmeric
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper
- 1/8 tsp cayenne
- 2 TB extra virgin olive oil

Instructies:
1. In a large bowl, whisk together all the spices to combine well. Add 2 TB olive oil and mix into a paste. Set aside.
2. Slice each thigh into quarters and add chicken into the bowl with the marinade. Use tongs or clean hands to thoroughly coat all pieces of chicken evenly, on all sides. Cover tightly with cling wrap and chill overnight (at least 3-4 hours.)
3. Let chicken come to room temp as you preheat oven to 400F, with rack on upper middle position.
4. Place chicken pieces in a single layer on a large, foil-lined baking sheet. Take care not to overlap or overcrowd the pieces. Roast 15 min or until just cooked.
5. Let chicken cool enough to handle. Slice chicken into thin slices and serve.

Recept: Steenbolk with hazelnut crumble, butternut and potatoes
Beschrijving: Steenbolk is a fish with a soft, delicate flavor that pairs perfectly with a crunchy hazelnut crumble, while butternut and potatoes provide an autumnal base. An easy dish that highlights pure flavors.
Bereidingstijd: 35 min

Ingrediënten:
- 600 g steenbolkfilets
-  butter
-  pepper
-  salt
- 350 g waxy potatoes (diced)
- 350 g butternut (diced)
- 1 red onion
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 thyme sprig
- 0.5 cube bouillon cube
- 2 tbsp sage (finely chopped)
- 50 g arugula
- 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley (finely chopped)
- 1 tbsp thyme leaves (finely chopped)
- 1 tbsp sage (finely chopped)
- 2 tbsp hazelnuts (chopped)
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 tbsp butter (room temperature)
- 2 tbsp aged cheese (grated)

Instructies:
1. Breng een ruime pot water met het bouillonblokje aan de kook. Kook de aardappel- en butternutblokjes 4 minuten beetgaar. Giet af en laat goed uitlekken.
2. Meng de peterselie, tijm, salie, hazelnoten, geraspte kaas en de geperste knoflook. Voeg de zachte boter toe en meng tot een kruimelig geheel.
3. Verwarm de oven voor op 180 °C.
4. Leg de steenbolkfilets op een met bakpapier beklede bakplaat en kruid met peper en zout. Verdeel de crumble over de vis.
5. Bak de steenbolk 10 à 12 minuten in de oven, tot de vis gaar is en de crumble mooi goudbruin kleurt.
6. Snipper de rode ui fijn. Rits de blaadjes van de tijm.
7. Smelt een klontje boter in een ruime pan en stoof de rode ui samen met de knoflook, de tijm en het laurierblaadje glazig. Voeg de voorgekookte aardappel- en butternutblokjes toe en bak ze enkele minuten goudbruin. Roer de fijngehakte salie erdoor en kruid met peper en zout.
8. Verdeel de groenten over de borden. Leg er de steenbolkfilets op en werk af met de rucola.

__data__.text:
Titel: Steenbolk with hazelnut crumble, butternut and potatoes
Tags: dinner, Belgian, steenbolk, butternut, potatoes, fish, autumn, oven, crumble

Beschrijving: This is a budget friendly and healthier alternative to many store-bought granolas. Serve with milk or yogurt to boost protein and make a complete breakfast.

- 1/3 cup honey
- 3 tbsp canola oil

metadata.Full_recipe:
Recept: Pasta vongole with whiting
Beschrijving: A classic from the Italian coastal cuisine with a North Sea twist. Vongole, whiting, and a touch of chili provide a light pasta full of flavor. Ideal for those who love pure ingredients and fish as the main feature.
Bereidingstijd: 30 min

Ingrediënten:
- 1000 g vongole (venus clams)
- 400 g spaghetti
- 1 shallot
- 1 red chili pepper
- 1 garlic clove
- 30 g flaked almonds
-  turmeric
-  olive oil
-  pepper
-  salt
- 200 ml white wine
- 400 g whiting fillets
-  fresh coriander or parsley

Instructies:
1. Rinse the vongole thoroughly under cold water and remove damaged or open ones that do not close when tapped.
2. Cook the spaghetti according to the instructions on the package.
3. Finely chop the shallot and cut the chili pepper into thin rings. Toast the flaked almonds in a dry frying pan until golden brown, then let cool.
4. Heat a generous splash of olive oil in a pan and sauté the shallot, chili pepper, and pressed garlic. Add the vongole and season with a pinch of turmeric, pepper, and salt.
5. Deglaze with the white wine, cover the pan, and let the vongole open over high heat.
6. Add the cooked spaghetti and mix well with the vongole.
7. Meanwhile, season the whiting fillets with pepper and salt. Fry them in a splash of olive oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
8. Divide the pasta among the plates. Place a whiting fillet on each and finish with the toasted flaked almonds and coriander, and serve immediately.

__data__.text:
Titel: Pasta vongole with whiting
Tags: dinner, Italian, vongole (venus clams), whiting, spaghetti, fish, seafood, easy, pasta

metadata.Full_recipe:
Recept: Pan-Fried Glazed Pork Chops by Jamie Oliver
Beschrijving: Try this delicious way to create moist and flavourful pork. Be sure to fry up the sage leaves – not only are they a great source of antioxidants (polyphenols) they taste incredible!
Bereidingstijd: 

Ingrediënten:
- 2 x 8-ounce or 4, 4 ounce pork chops or pork shoulder steaks
-  olive oil
-  sea salt (for better flavour profile)
-  freshly ground black pepper
- 4 sprigs (or more) fresh sage
- one lemon
- 2 large Tbsp. applesauce, mango chutney, apricot jam, maple syrup, or honey (to glaze)

Instructies:
1. Using a very sharp knife, or kitchen scissors, carefully trim the skin off the edges of each chop/steak – you’re going to turn this into crackling (optional).
2. Cut each strip of skin lengthways into 2 strips, so you end up with 4 strips in total.
3. Use a sharp knife to make cuts every 1/4 inch along the fat remaining on the chops—this will help it render and crisp up while cooking.
4. Rub both sides of the chops with olive oil and season really well with salt and pepper. While you’re at it, season your strips of skin.
5. Pick the sage leaves off their stalks, toss them lightly in a little olive oil, and put to one side.
6. Put a frying pan over a high heat and add your strips of skin. Move them about in the hot pan and remove them when golden, crisp, and crackling.
7. Lay both chops/steaks flat in the pan and give them 3-4 minutes on each side, turning every minute.
8. When they’re looking golden, add a few sage leaves to the pan. Let them crisp up and cook for about 30 seconds, then remove them to a plate.
9. Spoon a large tablespoon of your chosen glazing ingredient over each chop/steak. Keep turning the meat over until nicely coated.
10. Cook them until they are almost a dark reddish-golden color and wonderfully thick and sticky.
11. Remove to a plate and let them rest for a minute or two, squeezing over a little lemon juice if you want to balance out the sweetness.
12. Serve with the crackling (optional) the crispy sage leaves and rice or mashed potatoes to soak up the juices. Lovely with some dressed veggies and a fresh salad.

__data__.text:
Titel: Pan-Fried Glazed Pork Chops by Jamie Oliver
Tags: dinner, Global, pork, sage, glaze (applesauce/mango chutney/apricot jam/maple syrup/honey), pan-fried, glazed, Jamie Oliver

Beschrijving: A nutritious chickpea curry with green onion and coconut milk, inspired by Vancouver's Vij's restaurant. Chickpeas provide protein, fiber, and minerals, making this dish healthy and satisfying.
Bereidingstijd:

Recept: Quick Garden Omelette
Beschrijving: A quick omelette with potatoes, mushrooms, spinach, and cheese, designed for high protein and performance nutrition.
Bereidingstijd: 20

Ingrediënten:
- 1 tsp vegetable oil or similar
- 1 small (~1/2 cup) potato or yam (sliced into thin wedges, then coarsely chopped)
- 1/4 cup cremini (or any type) mushrooms (sliced)
- 4 large eggs (2 yolk and 4 whites) (separate 2 of the 4 yolks and discard)
- 2 cup bagged baby spinach leaves (coarsely chopped)
- 2 tbsp goat cheese (feta or cheddar work great too) (crumbled)
-  Salt and pepper (to taste)

Instructies:
1. Pan: Heat pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil, heat then add potatoes. Sauté 10 min. stirring occasionally.
2. Stir in mushrooms and sauté 8 min. or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from pan and set aside.
3. Pan: Wipe pan clean with paper towels. Spray with cooking oil if needed and heat to medium high heat.
4. Bowl: Combine eggs, a couple of shakes of salt and pepper in a bowl and whisk until eggs are frothy. Pour mixture into pan, and stir briskly with a heatproof spatula or wooden spoon until egg starts to thicken (~ 20 sec.).
5. Arrange half of potato mixture, 1 cup spinach, and 2 tbsp cheese over omelet.
6. Run spatula around edges and under omelet to loosen it from pan. Fold omelet in half and continue heating until all egg is cooked. Slide omelet onto a plate. Cut in half crosswise and enjoy.

__data__.text:
Titel: Quick Garden Omelette
Tags: breakfast, Global, eggs, potato, spinach, high protein, vegetarian, quick

Recept: Pineapple Thai Chicken Curry
Beschrijving:

Ingrediënten:
- 2 cups uncooked jasmine rice or rice noodles
- 4 cups water (for rice)
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil

Recept: Salad with pork roast and mustard dressing
Beschrijving: This salad mixes the best of both worlds: juicy, seasoned pork roast and a fresh mix of fennel, apple, and nuts. The mustard dressing adds spice, and the blue cheese (for those who like it) gives extra punch. Light, elegant, and perfect as lunch or dinner on summer days.
Bereidingstijd: 55 min

Ingrediënten:
- 600 g pork roast
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 tbsp rosemary leaves (finely chopped)
- 2 tbsp thyme
- 2 pieces garlic cloves
- 1 tsp mustard
-  butter
-  olive oil
- 2 fennel
- 2 apples
- 80 g lamb's lettuce
- 30 g walnuts
- 100 g blue cheese
- 2 tsp mustard
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tbsp white wine vinegar
- 3 tbsp olive oil
-  pepper
-  salt

Instructies:

Recept: Whole Wheat Pasta with Chickpeas and Escarole

- 1 head escarole (roughly chopped)

- 1/4 cup capers (drained and patted dry (optional))
- 5 cloves garlic (sliced)
- 1/2 cup fresh parsley (roughly chopped)
- 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
- 1 (28 oz.) can whole peeled tomatoes (crushed slightly, liquid reserved)
- 1 (15.5 oz.) can chickpeas (drained, rinsed and patted dry)
- 2 bay leaves
- 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese

Instructies:
1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions; add the escarole during the last 2 minutes, cover and do not stir. Remove the escarole with tongs; set aside. Add the capers and fry until crisp, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a paper-towel lined plate.

Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, a pinch of salt and the bay leaves. Cook until the tomatoes and chickpeas brown, about 6 minutes. Add the escarole and reserved tomato juice and cook until the sauce thickens slightly, about 4 more minutes. Remove and discard the bay leaves.
3. Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce; season with salt and pepper. (If the sauce is thick, add some reserved pasta water.) Stir in the cheese and top with fried capers, if using, and more cheese.

Recept: The New Noodle Casserole
Beschrijving: A performance-oriented noodle casserole with beef or turkey, bulgur, and dairy, approved by sport dietitians.
Bereidingstijd: 35

Ingrediënten:
- 2 bunches scallions (trimmed)
- 8 oz. extra lean ground beef (or turkey)
- 1 ½ tsp vegetable oil
- ½ cup bulgur
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 2 (8oz) cans tomato sauce
- ½ cup water
- 6 oz. no-yolk whole-wheat egg noodles
- 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese
- 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream
- 1/4 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese (shredded)
-  salt and pepper (to taste)

Instructies:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Coat a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While simmering pan ingredients below, cook noodles until just tender (6 to 8 min.). Drain and rinse under cold water.
4. Separate white and green parts of scallions; thinly slice and keep separately.
5. Cook beef in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up clumps with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink (3 to 5 min.). Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess fat.
6. Wipe out pan with paper towel, add oil and reduce heat to medium-low. Add bulgur, garlic and the scallion whites. Cook and stir until the scallions soften (5 to 7 min.). Add tomato sauce, water and the beef; bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer until the bulgur is tender and the sauce is thickened (15 to 20 min.). Season with salt and pepper.
7. Puree cottage cheese until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl; stir in sour cream and scallion greens.
8. Layer half of the noodles, half the cottage cheese mixture and half the meat sauce in the baking dish. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Sprinkle Cheddar over the top.
9. Bake casserole until bubbly, 30 to 40 min. Let stand for 10 min. before serving.

- 50 g arugula

Instructies:
1. Melt the butter and add the flour. Stir to make a roux and let it cook briefly. Gradually add the milk while stirring until you have a smooth sauce. Let it cook for a while.
2. Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the grated cheese until it is completely melted. Season with pepper and salt and set aside.
3. Fry the bacon slices in a pan until crispy. Add the honey at the end and let it cook briefly. Remove from the pan and drain on kitchen paper.
4. Fry the hamburgers in a pan with some butter until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Season with pepper and salt.
5. Halve the buns and spread the cut sides with some butter. Toast them briefly in a pan or grill pan.
6. Top the bottom halves of the buns with arugula. Place a hamburger on top and spoon over some cheese sauce. Divide the bacon slices over it and optionally finish with a little extra honey and arugula.

metadata.Full_recipe:
Recept: Baked Coconut Shrimp
Beschrijving: Baked coconut shrimp is a tropical-inspired main dish, oven-baked for a healthier twist, and can be served with Hawaiian rice and grilled vegetables.
Bereidingstijd: 30-45

Ingrediënten:
- ½ cup cornstarch
- ½ to 1 tsp ground red pepper
- ¼ tsp salt
- 1 tbsp honey
- 1 tbsp lime juice
- 3 egg whites
- 1 cup shredded coconut flakes
- 1 ½ lbs large raw shrimp (peeled and deveined, rinsed and patted dry OR you can use pre-cooked shrimp peeled with tails off)
-  cooking spray

Instructies:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Spray a large baking sheet with butter flavored cooking spray.
3. In a small bowl combine cornstarch, pepper and salt.
4. In a small microwave safe dish heat up honey approximately 30-45 seconds (careful not to overheat).
5. Add limejuice to honey and stir.
6. Slowly add in egg whites and continue to stir.
7. Place coconut in a thin layer on a plate.
8. Take each shrimp and first dip it into cornstarch mixture then in egg white mixture and finally roll in the coconut the then place on very greased baking sheet.
9. Bake 10-15 minutes or until shrimp is pink and the coconut is lightly toasted. Cooking time will be less with pre-cooked shrimp.

__data__.text:
Titel: Baked Coconut Shrimp
Tags: dinner, Global, shrimp, coconut, egg whites, tropical, oven-baked, seafood
